notesAboutQuality: Practice mode is an explicit source-voice derivative, not an attempt to collapse the complete piano texture into guitar.
Full Rendition is generated independently from the complete MXL and preserves both piano staves, voices, key changes, and source tempo map.
Practice playback defaults to half of the opening score tempo for easier study; Full Rendition uses the source tempo map at its default transport setting.
